desc:
🐲 Clash of Dragons awaits you, mighty dragon rider! 🐉

Master the art of aerial combat as you take control of a powerful dragon and battle rival riders in a brutal fight for dominance. Skill and strategy are your keys to victory—will you rise as the ultimate dragon rider?

💰 Roblox Premium players receive +50% boost on rewards in the AFK Zone

Note that this game is currently in a Pre-Alpha stage. Expect bugs and glitches and please have patience as we iron them out and release more content over time!

✨ Key Features
🔥 Choose your dragon and fight for your glory
⚔️ Master fast-paced PvP combat
🌌 Dominate the skies with skill and precision
👥 Team up or clash with friends
🏆 Prove you're the fiercest dragon rider in the realm!
🌟 Favorite and follow for exclusive updates and rewards!

Tags: Clash of Dragons, Dragons, Creature, Kaiju, PvP, Combat, Fantasy, Titan, Monster, Monsters, Strategy, Battle, Survival, Teamwork, Action
